scoring_justification: Checker recomputes absolute error between reported scalars/temperature profile and paper's experimental values.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold experimental values for BLT natural convection
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper: resonant frequency 17.64 kHz, maximum displacement 15.8 µm, capacitance 13200 pF; temperature profile approximated from measured dots in Fig. 11.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the experimental results the paper compared its simulation against; they are traceable to the paper's reported numbers.

outputs.description: Final computed characteristics of the bolt-clamped Langevin-type transducer under natural convection. The checker compares these reported values to the paper's experimental measurements using absolute difference within hidden tolerances.

output_contract.notes: The geometry and full material constants are described in the instruction. Only natural convection is required; forced convection is omitted. Thermal stress distribution is not scored.
